automos_note: UTMOSv2 and DistilMOS are automatic predictors of perceived MOS/naturalness. They are not human MOS measurements.

canonical_cross_model_stress_target.comparability_scope: Same semantic utterances and intended pronunciation target; frontend stress-resolution mechanisms are part of each system being compared.
canonical_cross_model_stress_target.description: All systems synthesize the same S01-S09 utterances with the same intended lexical stress. The pronunciation target is defined by text_stressed. Literal frontend input may differ according to each system's documented/native stress handling.

external_systems.stress_control: Use each system's native frontend pronunciation/stress handling with no manual stress injection.

project_melotts.stress_control: Explicit combining acute accent U+0301 is supplied to the Russian MeloTTS frontend.

melotts_plain_ablation.description: Project-only ablation with explicit stress marks removed. Used to quantify the effect of explicit stress control. Excluded from headline cross-model quality comparison.

conditional_metrics: WavLM speaker cosine similarity where target-speaker comparison is methodologically valid

performance_protocol.first_audio_definition: For native streaming systems: time until first playable audio chunk. For non-streaming systems: time until complete waveform first becomes available. delivery_mode must state which case applies.

purpose: Controlled cross-model comparison of Russian TTS systems for diploma defense.
reference_metric_note: The defense_qc_prompts_v2 artifact contains texts only and no matched natural reference WAVs. Full-reference speech quality metrics are therefore outside the primary cross-model benchmark.
reporting_rules: Project MeloTTS systems receive literal text_stressed with U+0301; external systems use text_plain through their native frontend pronunciation/stress handling.
WER/CER always use text_plain as the ASR reference.
WER/CER use the single pinned Whisper-small evaluator and ru_simple_v1 normalization.
UTMOSv2 and DistillMOS are automatic MOS predictions, not human MOS.
S04-excluded WER/CER values are diagnostic sensitivity analysis only and must not replace the primary metrics.
Performance results are local CPU two-thread measurements on the same machine.
Only native streaming systems receive a streaming TTFA entry.

stress_policy.future_work: Add automatic stress assignment/disambiguation before phonemization while preserving explicit user overrides.
stress_policy.project_melotts_current_limitation: Explicit stress control is supported, but automatic lexical stress assignment/correction is not part of the current inference frontend.
